title: Overview
subtitle: Cross-asset risk panorama: score / regime / drivers / AI brief

aiBrief.title: AI Market Brief
aiBrief.label: AI
aiBrief.degraded: AI brief unavailable (missing data or generation failure)
aiBrief.degradedHint: Market and risk data remain viewable; the brief will resume once automation produces it.
aiBrief.noFreshBasis: AI brief has no fresh basis
aiBrief.noFreshBasisHint: Input data is degraded or missing; the brief will resume when its inputs are fresh.
aiBrief.regimeIndeterminate: The market regime is indeterminate: no condition fired on the current inputs — the model has no read rather than a calm or alarming one.

analysisMissing.title: AI brief unavailable
analysisMissing.detail: The current-language brief is missing, so a complete bilingual brief cannot be shown.
analysisMissing.recovery: It will return after the next successful AI publication.

analysisMalformed.title: AI brief could not be validated
analysisMalformed.detail: One language file is malformed or fails its data contract.
analysisMalformed.recovery: The brief will return after the next valid publication.

pairIncomplete.title: Bilingual brief is incomplete
pairIncomplete.detail: Both language files are required before the brief can be shown as current.
pairIncomplete.recovery: It will return when the missing language file is published.

pairMismatch.title: Bilingual brief versions differ
pairMismatch.detail: The two language files do not describe the same analytical structure.
pairMismatch.recovery: It will return after a matching pair is published.

factsMissing.title: AI brief has no fact basis
factsMissing.detail: The current fact layer is unavailable, so the brief cannot be certified.
factsMissing.recovery: It will return after the fact layer is rebuilt successfully.

factsUnidentified.title: AI brief has no verified fact identity
factsUnidentified.detail: The fact layer does not carry a verifiable generation identity.
factsUnidentified.recovery: It will return after a fingerprinted fact layer is published.

lineageMissing.title: AI brief has no verified lineage
lineageMissing.detail: The language files do not say which fact generation they used.
lineageMissing.recovery: It will return after a lineage-backed pair is published.

lineageMismatch.title: AI brief basis does not match
lineageMismatch.detail: The brief and current facts belong to different generations.
lineageMismatch.recovery: It will return after automation publishes a pair for the current facts.

inputUnhealthy.title: AI brief has no fresh basis
inputUnhealthy.detail: Its fact inputs are delayed, stale, empty, degraded, or missing.
inputUnhealthy.recovery: It will return when its inputs are fresh.

delayed.title: AI brief is delayed
delayed.detail: The validated pair is older than its expected update window.
delayed.recovery: It will return to normal after the next successful data run.

stale.title: AI brief is stale
stale.detail: The validated pair is too old to present as current analysis.
stale.recovery: It will return after a new pair is generated from current facts.

empty.title: AI brief has no usable inputs
empty.detail: The current fact layer contains no usable observations for the brief.
empty.recovery: It will return after a non-empty fact layer is published.
